title: Morning Brief — Sunday, 18 October 2026
description: Australia's superannuation system hits a record $4.4 trillion as payday super and the 12% guarantee rate take effect, Queensland commits $66M to Gympie's water infrastructure to unlock new homes, and the Gold Coast's long-planned Ritz-Carlton at Mariner's Cove progresses. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made to listen to on the morning drive.
